Introduction
The versatile modular design of the compact EDS-600 series Ethernet network. Models with an extended operating temperature range of
switch allows users to combine fiber and copper modules to create -40 to 75°C are also available. The EDS-600 series supports several
switch solutions suitable for any automation network. The EDS-600’s reliable and intelligent functions, including IEEE 1588 PTP V2,
modular design lets you install up to 3 Gigabit Ethernet ports and 16 EtherNet/IP*, Modbus/TCP, LLDP, DHCP Option 82, SNMP Inform,
Fast Ethernet ports, and the advanced Turbo Ring and Turbo Chain QoS, IGMP snooping, VLAN, TACACS+*, IEEE 802.1X, HTTPS, SSH,
(recovery time < 20 ms) technology, RSTP/STP, and MSTP* helps SNMPv3, and more, making the Ethernet switches suitable for any
increase the reliability and availability of your industrial Ethernet harsh industrial environment.
*Available in Q3, 2011
Features and Benefits
• Command Line Interface (CLI) for quickly configuring major • IGMP snooping and GMRP for filtering multicast traffic
managed functions* • Port-based VLAN, IEEE 802.1Q VLAN, and GVRP to ease network
• Hot swap media modules for continuous operation planning
• Turbo Ring and Turbo Chain (recovery time < 20 ms), RSTP/STP, • QoS (IEEE 802.1p/1Q) and TOS/DiffServ to increase determinism
and MSTP* for network redundancy • Port Trunking for optimum bandwidth utilization
• IPv6 Ready logo awarded (IPv6 Logo Committee certified) • TACACS+*, SNMPv3, IEEE 802.1X, HTTPS, and SSH to enhance
• SNMP Inform for ensuring reliable event management network security
• LLDP for automated topology discovery • SNMPv1/v2c/v3 for different levels of network management
• DHCP Option 82 for IP address assignment with different policies • RMON for efficient network monitoring and proactive capability
• IEEE 1588 PTP V2 (Precision Time Protocol) for precise time • Bandwidth management prevents unpredictable network status
synchronization of networks • Lock port function for blocking unauthorized access based on MAC
• Support EtherNet/IP* and Modbus/TCP protocols for device address
management and monitoring • Port mirroring for online debugging
• Compatible with EtherNet/IP and PROFINET protocols for • Automatic warning by exception through e-mail, relay output
transparent data transmission • Digital inputs to integrate sensors and alarms with IP networks
